sentences.en: So Byron and Hobhouse have been travelling from Albania through the autumn and into the winter, through Greece, and they're heading for Athens.
sentences.zh: 因此，拜伦和霍布豪斯从秋天到冬天一直在从阿尔巴尼亚出发，穿过希腊，朝着雅典进发。

sentences.en: And they arrive in Athens on Christmas Day, 1809.
sentences.zh: 他们在1809年圣诞节那天抵达雅典。

sentences.en: And unsurprisingly, when they arrive there, full of visions of the Athens, of Pericles and Phidias and Socrates,
sentences.zh: 毫不奇怪，当他们满怀对雅典、对伯里克利、菲狄亚斯和苏格拉底的憧憬抵达那里时，

sentences.en: they're incredibly disappointed because Athens is a pretty run-down, bedraggled, squalid shadow of what it had once been.
sentences.zh: 他们感到无比失望，因为雅典已经变得相当破败、邋遢和肮脏，完全失去了往日的风采。

sentences.en: Kind of weeds growing in the cracks in the pavements kind of thing, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 就像人行道裂缝里长满杂草那种感觉，对吧？

sentences.en: Narrow, crooked streets.
sentences.zh: 狭窄而曲折的街道。

sentences.en: I mean, there's no more than 10,000 people living there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那里生活的人口不超过一万人。

sentences.en: And Hobhouse goes to walk around the walls and he times himself and takes him 47 minutes.
sentences.zh: 霍布豪斯去沿着城墙走了一圈，他给自己计时，花了47分钟。

sentences.en: But, again, Byron kind of loves Athens.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，拜伦其实很喜欢雅典。

sentences.en: He'll be incredibly happy there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里会过得极其快乐。

sentences.zh: 院子正中间有一棵柠檬树。

sentences.en: Unlike Albania, there are lots of international visitors there.
sentences.zh: 和阿尔巴尼亚不同，那里有很多国际游客。

sentences.en: Byron's kind of people.
sentences.zh: 都是拜伦喜欢的那类人。

sentences.en: You know, he settles into kind of expat life.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他开始适应这种侨民生活。

sentences.en: There's a lot of kind of editing going on of Byron's papers.

sentences.en: And, in fact, Hobhouse, while he's out there, makes Byron burn a whole load of stuff that Byron's written.
sentences.zh: 事实上，霍布豪斯在当地逗留期间，让拜伦烧毁了大量拜伦写的东西。

sentences.en: So we can't be absolutely certain.

sentences.en: But I think probably both.
sentences.zh: 但我认为大概两者都有。

sentences.en: You know, there are lots of antiquities.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那里有很多古代遗迹。

sentences.en: And Byron has this kind of growing sympathy for the cause of Greek liberty.
sentences.zh: 拜伦对希腊自由事业的同情心日益增长。

sentences.en: And I think that it's that sense that he is there to defend Greece that makes him find in Lord Elgin's transportation of the friezes from the Parthenon a way of channeling that.
sentences.zh: 我认为正是这种守护希腊的使命感，让他把埃尔金勋爵将帕特农神庙饰带运走的举动，视为宣泄这种情绪的一种方式。

sentences.en: Because Lord Elgin is Scottish.
sentences.zh: 因为埃尔金勋爵是苏格兰人。

sentences.en: Byron's mother is Scottish.
sentences.zh: 拜伦的母亲是苏格兰人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so Byron comes to see Lord Elgin as the embodiment of everything that he's escaped.
sentences.zh: 因此，拜伦将埃尔金勋爵视为他极力想要逃离的一切事物的化身。

sentences.en: So the provincialism that he associates with Britain, the philistinism, and as I say, above all, his mother, who he's never particularly got on with.
sentences.zh: 也就是他所联想到的英国的狭隘眼光、庸俗作风，而且正如我所说，最重要的是他的母亲，他从来没跟她怎么合得来。

sentences.en: So kind of deep waters.
sentences.zh: 所以情况有点复杂。

sentences.en: So the way that Byron comes to be obsessed by the Elgin marbles is that two days after they've arrived, so the 27th of December, he and Hobhouse have visited by an art connoisseur
sentences.zh: 拜伦之所以对埃尔金大理石浮雕如此着迷，是因为在他们到达两天后，也就是12月27日，他和霍布豪斯接待了一位艺术鉴赏家

sentences.en: and collector from Naples by the name of Giovanni Battista Lussieri.

sentences.zh: 但无论如何，卢西耶里被威廉·汉密尔顿派去绘制古代文物的图纸。

sentences.en: And then in 1799, he's hired by Lord Elgin, who at the time is the ambassador to
sentences.zh: 然后在1799年，他被时任驻

sentences.zh: 君士坦丁堡大使的埃尔金勋爵雇佣，为他绘制古文物的图纸。

sentences.en: And Lussieri reports back to Elgin in Constantinople that on the Parthenon, there are these friezes that date back to the original building of the temple in the time of Pericles.
sentences.zh: 卢西耶里向身在君士坦丁堡的埃尔金汇报说，在帕特农神庙上，有一些可以追溯到伯里克利时期神庙初建时的饰带。

sentences.en: They're very, very beautiful, but they are also deteriorating very, very fast and badly.
sentences.zh: 它们非常非常精美，但同时也正在以非常非常快且严重的速度退化。

sentences.en: And so therefore Elgin worried about the fact that they may not last very long.
sentences.zh: 因此，埃尔金担心它们可能维持不了多久。

sentences.en: And so Elgin, because he's been told that they're deteriorating, gets permission for Lussieri to go and make casts of them.
sentences.zh: 所以埃尔金听说它们正在恶化后，就获得了许可，让卢西耶里去为它们制作拓模。

sentences.en: And so the scaffolding goes up and Lussieri is able to go up and look at the friezes up close.
sentences.zh: 于是脚手架搭了起来，卢西耶里得以走上去近距离观察这些饰带。

sentences.en: He reports back to Elgin and says, yeah, they're brilliant.
sentences.zh: 他向埃尔金汇报说，没错，它们太棒了。

sentences.en: They're even better than I'd imagined.
sentences.zh: 比我想象的还要好。

sentences.en: And Elgin then thinks, well,
sentences.zh: 然后埃尔金就想，好吧，

sentences.en: I've got the scaffolding up.
sentences.zh: 既然脚手架都搭好了。

sentences.en: They're deteriorating.
sentences.zh: 它们又在不断损毁。

sentences.en: Why not take them back?
sentences.zh: 为什么不把它们带回去呢？

sentences.en: 10 down.
sentences.zh: 十个下来。

sentences.zh: 为什么不把它们移走呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 所以他——我的意思是，他通过行贿来获得移走它们的许可，但当时所有人都在行贿。

sentences.en: That's the way things are done.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这么办的。

sentences.en: That's the Ottoman system.
sentences.zh: 这就是奥斯曼帝国的体制。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And no objections are raised at the time, either by the Turkish government or by any Greek, about what Elgin is doing.
sentences.zh: 当时无论是土耳其政府还是任何希腊人，都没有对埃尔金的行为提出任何异议。

sentences.en: And in fact, the only objection comes from the garrison on the Acropolis, because the Acropolis is the Ottoman military garrison, who are worried that Lussieri's workmen
sentences.zh: 事实上，唯一的反对意见来自于卫城的卫戍部队，因为卫城是奥斯曼帝国的军事驻地，他们担心卢西耶里的工人们

sentences.en: will be able to peer into the garrison's harem.
sentences.zh: 能够窥探到卫戍部队的后宫。

sentences.en: I love that detail.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这个细节。

sentences.en: And so this has been ongoing for 10 years.
sentences.zh: 这种情况已经持续了10年。

sentences.en: And just before Byron's arrival, the last frieze has been taken down and is down at Piraeus, the port of Athens, waiting to be shipped off.
sentences.zh: 就在拜伦抵达之前，最后一块饰带刚刚被拆下，运到了雅典的港口比雷埃夫斯，等待装船运走。

sentences.en: It took them 10 years to take all this down.
sentences.zh: 他们花了10年时间才把这些全部拆下来。

sentences.en: Yeah, it takes that long.
sentences.zh: 对，要花那么长时间。

sentences.en: And what is kind of adding jeopardy to the whole thing is that, of course, the French are sniffing around it as well.
sentences.zh: 让整件事雪上加霜的是，法国人显然也在周围虎视眈眈。

sentences.en: And so the whole process is dependent on Britain maintaining its alliance with the Ottomans, because the Anglo-French rivalry is kind of echoing through the Ottoman Empire as well.
sentences.zh: 因此整个过程取决于英国能否维持与奥斯曼帝国的同盟关系，因为英法竞争的余波也在奥斯曼帝国境内回荡。

sentences.en: And Napoleon has an agent right on the spot, doesn't he, who's trying to get the friezes himself?

sentences.en: So good timing for Elgin.
sentences.zh: 所以埃尔金的时机抓得真好。

sentences.en: And they're appalled by what they see, because of course, they have this image of it as something from the time of Pericles.

sentences.en: But as we said, it's a garrison.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们所说，这是一个军事驻地。

sentences.en: And so there are gun palisades all over the place.
sentences.zh: 所以到处都是炮台栅栏。

sentences.en: You know, all the various temples are part of the fortifications.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，所有不同的神庙都成了防御工事的一部分。

sentences.en: The garrison have their white houses anywhere that there isn't an antiquity.
sentences.zh: 只要不是古迹的地方，驻军都建了自己的白色房屋。

sentences.zh: 一枚炮弹击中了军火库，帕特农神庙便发生了大爆炸。

sentences.zh: 拜伦和霍布豪斯被带去看了炮弹落下的那个地面上的大洞。

sentences.en: Now, hobhouse and Byron react in very, very different ways to what they're shown.
sentences.zh: 现在，霍布豪斯和拜伦对他们所看到的东西作出了截然不同的反应。

sentences.zh: 霍布豪斯在他的日记中写道，一个工人告诉他，上面的人都在把大理石饰带烧成石灰，每当他们需要搞建设

sentences.en: projects, they just chuck them in.
sentences.zh: 项目时，就把它们直接扔进去。

sentences.en: Why wouldn't they?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: And if you burn it, you can basically melt it down or whatever.
sentences.zh: 如果你把它烧了，基本上就能把它熔化或者怎么样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that is ongoing.
sentences.zh: 所以这种事一直在发生。

sentences.en: And that's what's happening.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: And so hobhouse thinks, thank God we're rescuing them.
sentences.zh: 因此霍布豪斯心想，谢天谢地我们在抢救它们。

sentences.en: So this is what hobhouse writes in his journal.
sentences.zh: 这就是霍布豪斯在日记中写的内容。

sentences.en: If the progress of decay should continue to be as rapid as it has been for more than a century past, there will in a few years be not one marble standing

sentences.zh: 将不会剩下一块完好的大理石。

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.zh: 并将其视为反希腊的存在，真的。

sentences.en: and to be pristine and perfect.
sentences.zh: 他对移走我们过去称之为埃尔金大理石浮雕（即帕特农神庙饰带）的敌意，大概源于他希望希腊属于他，并且保持原汁原味和完美无瑕。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And here is the British establishment, of which he is the product.
sentences.zh: 这就是英国建制，而他正是这个建制的产物。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But which he resents.
sentences.zh: 但他对此深感愤慨。

sentences.en: Here is the British establishment.
sentences.zh: 这就是英国建制。

sentences.en: Taking a bit of his Greece, preserving it and taking it back to Britain.
sentences.zh: 攫取他希腊的一部分，将其保留，然后带回英国。

sentences.zh: 而他将此视为对个人的冒犯，不是吗？

sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he'll be walking around in, you know, his massive multicolored trousers, you know, molesting boys or whatever.
sentences.zh: 他会穿着那种，你知道的，极其招摇的彩色裤子到处走，你知道的，调戏小男孩之类的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.zh: 然而苏格兰又一次追上了他。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's absolutely true.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得这绝对千真万确。

sentences.en: And I think that the sense of the contrast between the grim Aberdonian childhood that he had endured with the hideous nursery maid and, you know, his mother being awful and
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，那种对比感——他与可怕的女保姆在阿伯丁度过的严酷童年，还有他那糟糕的母亲，以及

sentences.en: everything.
sentences.zh: 种种一切。

sentences.en: And Greece is sharpened by the fact that, you know, Byron is absolutely at this point living his best life.
sentences.zh: 再加上这样一个事实：此时此刻，拜伦正在尽情享受人生，这让希腊之行显得更加鲜明。

sentences.en: I mean, there's no question about it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是毫无疑问的。

sentences.en: He is having a lovely time.
sentences.zh: 他过得很愉快。

sentences.en: So he spends 10 weeks in Athens and then he crosses the Aegean and all this kind of posing amid ruins.
sentences.zh: 所以在雅典待了10周后，他横渡了爱琴海，诸如此类在废墟中摆造型的行为。

sentences.en: I mean, it's the essence of the Byronic.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这就是拜伦式的精髓。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 爱琴海的另一边也有大量宏伟的废墟。

sentences.en: So he goes to
sentences.zh: 所以他去了

sentences.en: Ephesus, a place that I'm sure lots of people listening to this may have gone on holiday when they go to Turkey, but there's nothing there.
sentences.zh: 以弗所，一个我相信很多听这个节目的听众去土耳其度假时可能去过的地方，但那里其实什么也没有。

sentences.en: Byron goes and rides out among the ruins and he reports that he hears thousands of jackals howling there.
sentences.zh: 拜伦去废墟中骑马游荡，并报告说他听到那里有成千上万只胡狼在嚎叫。

sentences.en: And then he goes to perhaps the most atmospheric and celebrated ancient site, possibly in the, in the whole of Turkey, which is the Troad, the place where Troy had stood.
sentences.zh: 然后他去了那个或许最具氛围、最著名的古代遗址，可能在整个土耳其都是如此，那就是特洛阿德，也就是特洛伊曾经所在地。

sentences.en: Now this is long before Schliemann will come and dig it up.
sentences.zh: 这远在施li曼（Schliemann）前来发掘它之前。

sentences.en: And there are all kinds of people who say that Troy had never existed.
sentences.zh: 当时有各种各样的人说特洛伊根本不存在。

sentences.en: Byron is very contemptuous of this.
sentences.zh: 拜伦对此极其不屑。

sentences.en: So in Don Juan, he will say, I've stood upon Achilles' tomb and heard
sentences.zh: 所以在《唐璜》中，他会写道：“我曾站在阿喀琉斯的墓前，听到

sentences.zh: 特洛伊遭到质疑。”

sentences.en: Time will doubt of Rome.
sentences.zh: “时间也将对罗马产生怀疑。”

sentences.en: For Byron, it's all very vivid.
sentences.zh: 对拜伦来说，这一切都极其生动。

sentences.en: It's all very real.
sentences.zh: 一切都非常真实。

sentences.en: It's all true.
sentences.zh: 一切都是真的。

sentences.en: And he wants to participate in the dimension of myth.
sentences.zh: 他渴望参与到神话的维度中去。

sentences.en: And the most famous way in which he demonstrates this is that on the 3rd of May, 1810, he swims the Hellespont.
sentences.zh: 他展示这一点最著名的方式是，在1810年5月3日，他游过了赫勒斯滂海峡。

sentences.en: So the Hellespont is the sea that separates Europe and Asia, you know, in Turkey.
sentences.zh: 所以赫勒斯滂海峡就是分隔欧洲和亚洲的海，你知道的，在土耳其境内。

sentences.en: That is gutsy to be fair to him.
sentences.zh: 说实话，他确实很有种。

sentences.en: Well, it is gutsy because this is a period where lots of people don't swim.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实很有种，因为这是一个很多人都不会游泳的时代。

sentences.en: So we talked about John
sentences.zh: 所以我们之前谈到过约翰

sentences.en: Edelston, the choir boy in Cambridge, who supposedly had drowned.
sentences.zh: 埃尔德森，剑桥的唱诗班男孩，据说他就是淹死的。

sentences.en: I mean, this is perfectly plausible.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这完全说得通。

sentences.en: People can't basically swim.
sentences.zh: 人们基本上都不会游泳。

sentences.zh: 不久之后，拜伦最著名的朋友之一，诗人珀西

sentences.en: Shelley, the poet, he will drown as well.
sentences.zh: 雪莱，也将溺水身亡。

sentences.en: But Byron loves swimming.
sentences.zh: 但拜伦热爱游泳。

sentences.en: And that of course is because he's lame.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是因为他脚跛。

sentences.zh: 他有内翻足。

sentences.en: And so in the water, it's as good as anybody.
sentences.zh: 所以在水里，他不逊于任何人。

sentences.en: He's perfectly mobile.

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 而且他抓住每一个游泳的机会。

sentences.zh: 所以在完成

sentences.zh: 赫勒斯滂海峡之前，他实际上已经游过了一个更让人印象深刻的长度，那就是横渡里斯本的特茹河。

sentences.en: Oh, that's quite a distance.
sentences.zh: 哦，那可是一段相当长的距离。

sentences.zh: 所以这是一个难度大得多的壮举。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 但当然，赫勒斯滂海峡最具浪漫色彩，因为在希腊神话中，利安德曾游过海去见他在对岸塔楼里的爱人海洛。

sentences.en: And so Byron wants to emulate the feat of Leander in swimming across.
sentences.zh: 所以拜伦想要效仿利安德横渡海峡的壮举。

sentences.en: And he does it in an hour and 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 他用了一个小时零十分钟完成了。

sentences.en: And he's accompanied by an officer in the Royal Navy, Lieutenant William Eckenhead.
sentences.zh: 陪伴他的是皇家海军的一名军官，威廉·埃肯黑德中尉。

sentences.en: And again, years later, he's still incredibly proud of it.
sentences.zh: 而且多年以后，他依然对此感到无比骄傲。

sentences.en: So again, he writes about it in Don
sentences.zh: 所以同样地，他在《唐

sentences.zh: 璜》中写道，这是一项我们引以为豪的壮举。

sentences.en: Leander, Mr. Eckenhead, and I did.
sentences.zh: 利安德，埃肯黑德先生，还有我，我们做到了。

sentences.en: So very, very proud of it.
sentences.zh: 所以对此感到非常非常骄傲。

sentences.en: Hmm.

sentences.zh: 也罢。

sentences.zh: 所以他们现在正乘船顺着赫勒斯滂海峡向上，朝着君士坦丁堡驶去。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 奥斯曼帝国的首都。

sentences.zh: 他们在5月13日抵达那里。

sentences.zh: 他们不被允许进入老君士坦丁堡，也就是拜占庭帝国和后来的奥斯曼帝国的权力中心。

sentences.zh: 金角湾与老君士坦丁堡中心遥遥相对的另一侧。

sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 这里现在可以说是伊斯坦布尔的商业中心。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And they find it a kind of weird and for Byron, exciting mix of the exotic and the familiar.
sentences.zh: 他们发现这里对拜伦来说是一种奇异而又令人兴奋的结合，既充满异国情调又带着熟悉感。

sentences.zh: 所以他们必须从载他们来的船上换乘小船，你知道的，小船会把他们划到加拉塔的港口。

sentences.zh: 当他们前行时，他们抬头看着宫殿的后墙，看到了后宫的所在地，还看到狗在墙下的尸体上撕咬着一具尸体。

sentences.en: And this, like so much that Byron sees on his trips, this will inspire him later when he comes to write a poem called The Siege of Corinth.
sentences.zh: 这就像拜伦旅途中看到的许多事情一样，后来当他开始写一首名为《科林斯围城》的诗时，这给予了他灵感。

sentences.en: He saw the lean dogs beneath the wall, holder the dead, their carnival, gorging and growling a carcass and limb.

sentences.en: They were too busy to bark at him.
sentences.zh: 它们忙得甚至都没空对他吠叫。

sentences.en: But against that, when he arrives there, they find there's a hotel with a billiard table.
sentences.zh: 但与此相对的是，当他们到达那里时，他们发现有一家带台球桌的酒店。

sentences.en: Oh, brilliant.
sentences.zh: 哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: Which they haven't had, you know, for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们已经很久没见过这东西了。

sentences.en: This is like the ultimate 19th century British trip, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这简直就是终极版的19世纪英国人旅行，对吧？

sentences.en: Like dead dogs, but also billiards.
sentences.zh: 既有死狗，又能打台球。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so Byron is now, I mean, he's very much at home.
sentences.zh: 所以现在的拜伦，我的意思是，他非常自在。

sentences.en: He's having a lovely time and he's basically become a figure of kind of beauty and glamour, not just for fellow Westerners, but even for the Turks themselves.
sentences.zh: 他过得很开心，而且他基本上成了一种美丽和迷人的象征，不仅对同为西方人的人如此，甚至对土耳其人本身也是如此。

sentences.en: So they find him fascinating.
sentences.zh: 所以他们觉得他极其迷人。

sentences.en: And on the 10th of July, he is received by the Sultan.
sentences.zh: 在7月10日，他受到了苏丹的接见。

sentences.en: Mahmoud II, Tom.
sentences.zh: 马哈茂德二世，汤姆。

sentences.en: So he's famous in the Ottoman world because he's the guy who's cracked down on the power of the Janissaries, who are the great kind of, they've been selected to be an

sentences.zh: 精锐军事部队并掌握着权力。

sentences.en: They've been that kind of Praetorian guard, but also Mahmoud ends up being a great Westernizer.
sentences.zh: 他们曾扮演那种近卫军的角色，但马哈茂德最终也成了一个伟大的西方化推行者。

sentences.en: So he anticipates what's called the Tantamats, which is the great period of reform for the Ottoman Empire.
sentences.zh: 所以他预示了所谓的坦齐马特，也就是奥斯曼帝国伟大的改革时期。

sentences.en: And he loves Byron, doesn't he?
sentences.zh: 他很喜欢拜伦，不是吗？

sentences.en: He's very taken with Byron.
sentences.zh: 他非常迷恋拜伦。

sentences.zh: 所以有一个见证人记录了这一点。

sentences.zh: 他说苏丹对拜伦年轻而惊艳的外表以及华丽的服饰留下了深刻的印象。

sentences.en: And in fact, the Sultan thinks that Byron is a woman dressed as a man.
sentences.zh: 事实上，苏丹认为拜伦是一个女扮男装的女人。

sentences.en: And he always thinks that.
sentences.zh: 而且他一直都这么认为。

sentences.en: And kind of what's intriguing about that is that Byron has, over the course of his trip, been exploring his female side.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，拜伦在整个旅行过程中一直在探索他女性化的一面。

sentences.en: So Hobhouse, while they're in Athens and recorded in his journal, dined to bed after Byron dressing up in female apparel and dancing with Demetrius.

sentences.en: And in Don Juan, his hero, Don Juan, enters the harem disguised as a slave girl.
